title: Microsoft Cybersecurity Analyst Professional Certificate
description: Prepare for a new career in this high-demand field with professional training from Microsoft — an industry-recognized leader in cybersecurity. The role of a cybersecurity analyst includes monitoring networks for vulnerabilities or potential threats, mitigating attacks on the network infrastructures, and implementing strategies for data protection. With 95% of fortune 500 companies using Azure, it’s critical for cybersecurity professionals to learn to protect data within an Azure environment.

title: IBM Cybersecurity Analyst Professional Certificate (V2)
description: The credential earner is ready for a career in cybersecurity with demonstrated ability to solve real-world problems. They understand cybersecurity analyst tools including data protection; endpoint protection; SIEM; system and network fundamentals; and key compliance and threat intelligence issues vital in today’s cybersecurity landscape. The earner has also gained skills for incident responses and forensics. The earner can also apply generative AI techniques to real-world cyberscurity scenarios.

title: Cybersecurity Job Search, Resume, and Interview Prep
description: This badge earner can describe the role of a Cybersecurity professional and career path options. They have demonstrated proficiency in performing job searches and creating a tailored portfolio, elevator pitch, resume, and cover letter. The badge holder understands how to expand their professional network. They comprehend the interview process and how to prepare for an interview and respond to different types of interview questions. They are also familiar with the post-interview next steps.

title: Generative AI Essentials for Cybersecurity
description: This badge earner understands the role of generative AI in cybersecurity. They know the importance of quality training data and transparency in LLMs. The individual has gained insight into enhancing incident response and forensic analyses using generative AI, EDR, and SIEM functions for threat detection and the role of cybersecurity playbooks in incident report summarization. They recognize challenges in generative AI, from risk exploration to ChatGPT and ethical considerations in cybersecurity.

title: CompTIA Security+ and CompTIA CySA+ Exam Readiness
description: This badge earner has demonstrated their readiness for the CompTIA Security+ and CompTIA CySA+ exams by completing rigorous, timed exams. The badge earner can locate study resources, apply study strategies, and describe the CompTIA Security+ and CompTIA CySA+ required and recommended exam eligibility requirements. They are knowledgeable of the exam process including voucher procurement and exam registration. This badge earner is prepared to pursue these CompTIA cybersecurity certifications.

title: Cybersecurity Breach Case Studies
description: This badge earner can research and describe breach cases including the following scenarios: A third party software company breach where multiple clients are affected; Ransomware threats and the consequences to organizations; Exposed data through misconfigured servers; and the effects of a phishing attack and cybersecurity criminal threats. The earner can investigate a real-world security breach identifying the attack, vulnerabilities, costs and prevention recommendations.

title: Incident Response and Digital Forensics
description: The badge earner demonstrates expertise in incident response and digital forensics using NIST and SANS frameworks to effectively manage cybersecurity incidents, collect and analyze digital evidence, and recover data using industry tools. They can now apply their practical, hands-on experience to strategize and develop incident response preparation, detection, containment, and reporting processes to help prevent, investigate, and resolve cybersecurity incidents.

title: Penetration Testing, Threat Hunting, and Cryptography
description: The badge earner has shown expertise in penetration testing, threat hunting, and cryptography. They have developed skills to identify and exploit vulnerabilities while investigating and mitigating potential threats. Using frameworks like PTES and OWASP, the badge earner has structured and executed penetration tests. They also understand threat hunting operations and how to apply cryptographic techniques to safeguard sensitive information, using various tools and best practices.

title: Cybersecurity Architecture V2
description: This badge earner has demonstrated foundational to advanced cybersecurity knowledge, including the CIA triad, IAM, endpoints, and network, application, and data security. Through hands-on labs, they have applied MFA, identified threats, responded to incidents, and developed strategies to improve organizational security.

title: Database Essentials and Vulnerabilities
description: This badge earner understands the concepts of relational and non-relational databases and can implement various data protection techniques to secure sensitive information. They know how to configure and manage database user profiles, password policies, privileges, and roles. They can identify, analyze, and mitigate database injection vulnerabilities, including OS command and SQL injection. The badge earner can also design and implement comprehensive database and application auditing models.

title: Network Security & Database Vulnerabilities
description: This badge earner understands network basics around the TCP/IP and OSI Models, as well as recount DNS, DHCP, Switching and Routing concepts. They can describe the structures and vulnerabilities of key databases for cybersecurity including SQL, Couch, Oracle and MongoDB.

title: Operating Systems: Overview, Administration, and Security
description: This badge earner understands the key cybersecurity concepts related to operating systems. They have a basic understanding of architecture, file systems, security features, and user accounts in Windows, macOS, and Linux. They can use command-line tools to perform basic administrative tasks. The badge earner is also familiar with virtualization as it relates to operating systems and cloud computing.

title: Introduction to Cybersecurity Tools and Cyberattacks V3
description: This badge earner has demonstrated their understanding of the fundamentals of cybersecurity tools and cyberattacks. They can describe the importance of critical thinking and the various types of cyber threats. They can explain internet security threats, cybersecurity controls, authentication and access controls, and physical threats and controls. The badge earner is prepared to describe cyber threats and preventive methods when seeking a career in cybersecurity.

title: Cybersecurity Essentials
description: This badge earner has demonstrated intermediate skills in cybersecurity topics and best practices. They understand concerns related to the CIA triad, information privacy, authentication, authorization, accounting, and encryption. They are able to identify common types of security threats, breaches, social engineering, and malware and have demonstrated an ability to harden devices and perform password management and browser security configuration.

title: Introduction to Cybersecurity Careers
description: This badge earner can compare the roles and responsibilities of various careers within the cybersecurity field and knows how to progress from one level to the next level. They can map IT fundamental, technical, and soft skills at various levels in cybersecurity. They know the required certifications for different job roles and the contents of each certification. The earner has discovered the various roles in cybersecurity and learned how to prepare for their chosen career path.

title: Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate(v.2)
description: This course is offered through Coursera, which is an ACE Authorized Instructional Platform. The course objective is to learn from cybersecurity experts at Google and gain in-demand skills that prepare learners for entry-level roles like cybersecurity analyst, security operations center (SOC) analyst, and more.

title: Networking Basics
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Networking Basics course and achieved this student level credential. Earner has knowledge of the types of networks, how they work, how devices send and receive data, the types of network cabling, how IP addresses find information on the Internet, how transport and applications operate, and has practiced building a home wireless network. Participated in up to 13 Cisco Packet Tracer activities.

title: Fortinet NSE 2 Certified in Cybersecurity
description: The NSE 2 in Cybersecurity certification validates that the badge earner has mastered the technical skills and knowledge that are required to identify and describe the core features of Next Generation Firewalls.

title: Introduction to the Next Generation Firewall 1.0
description: Introduction to the Next Generation Firewall 1.0 exam badge recognizes that the badge earner has mastered the technical skills and knowledge that are required to identify and describe the core features of Next Generation Firewalls.

title: AWS Cloud Quest: Security - Training Badge
description: Earners of this badge have demonstrated efficient use of AWS security services to build solutions. Badge earners have acquired hands-on experience deploying solutions that respond to incidents, remediate quickly, detect vulnerabilities and prevent data loss.

title: AWS Cloud Quest: Cloud Practitioner - Training Badge
description: Earners of this badge have demonstrated basic solution building knowledge using AWS services and have a fundamental understanding of AWS Cloud concepts. Badge earners have acquired hands-on experience with compute, networking, database and security services.

title: AWS Academy Graduate - Cloud Foundations - Training Badge
description: Earners of this badge have taken the AWS Academy Cloud Foundations course.

title: Fortinet NSE 3 Certified in Cybersecurity
description: The NSE 3 in Cybersecurity certification validates that the badge earner can run high-level operations on a FortiGate device. The knowledge domain covers the fundamentals of operating the most common FortiGate features.

title: Fortinet Certified Associate Cybersecurity
description: The Fortinet Certified Associate in Cybersecurity certification validates that the earner can run high-level operations on a FortiGate device. The curriculum covers the fundamentals of operating the most common FortiGate features.

title: Fortinet FortiGate 7.6 Operator
description: The FortiGate 7.6 Operator exam badge recognizes expertise in the common features of implementing and operating a FortiGate device. The badge earner has demonstrated knowledge of basic configuration, operation, and day-to-day administration.

title: Cisco Networking Academy Learn-A-Thon 2026
description: This badge is awarded to students who participated in a Learn-A-Thon event organized by a local Networking Academy.

title: Junior Cybersecurity Analyst Career Path
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Junior Cybersecurity Analyst Career Path with Cisco Networking Academy. They understand techniques to monitor and protect the network, including firewalls, cloud security, and cryptography, they are familiar with security alerts and governance, and they have skills to perform network vulnerability assessment and create a risk management plan, including forensic investigations and incident response planning.

title: CCNA: Switching, Routing, and Wireless Essentials
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Switching, Routing, and Wireless Essentials course and achieved this student level credential. The earner has a foundation in switching operations, wired and wireless LAN configuration using security best practices, redundancy protocols, and developed problem-solving skills. Earner participated in up to 45 practice activities and accumulated up to 21 hours of hands-on labs using Cisco hardware and/or the Cisco Packet Tracer tool.

title: CCNA: Introduction to Networks
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Introduction to Networks course and achieved this student level credential. Earner has knowledge of networking including IP addressing, how physical, data link protocols support Ethernet, can configure connectivity between switches, routers and end devices to provide access to local and remote resources. Earner participated in up to 54 labs and accumulated up to 14 hours of hands-on labs using Cisco hardware or Packet Tracer tool

title: Network Defense
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Network Defense course. The holder of this student-level credential has a broad understanding of techniques to monitor and protect the network, including access control, firewalls, cloud security, and cryptography. They are also familiar with how to evaluate and respond to security alerts.

title: Ethical Hacker
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Ethical Hacker course. The holder of this student level credential has a broad understanding of the legal and compliance requirements and is proficient in the art of scoping, executing, reporting vulnerability assessments, and recommending mitigation strategies. The holder has completed up to 34 hands-on activities using Kali Linux, WebSploit, and other tools.

title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Introduction to Cybersecurity course. The holder of this student-level credential has introductory knowledge of cybersecurity, including the global implications of cyber threats on industries, and why cybersecurity is a growing profession. They understand vulnerabilities and threat detection and defense. They also have insight into opportunities available with pursuing cybersecurity certifications.

title: Endpoint Security
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Endpoint Security course. The holder of this student-level credential has a broad understanding of basic concepts of network security, as well as operating systems and endpoint security.

title: Cyber Threat Management
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Cyber Threat Management course. The holder of this student-level credential is familiar with cybersecurity policies and governance to ensure an organization complies with ethics standards and legal and regulatory frameworks. They understand how to do a network vulnerability assessment and create a risk management plan, as well as post-incident response.
skills: The Diamond Model Of Intrusion Analysis

title: Linux Essentials
description: Cisco, in collaboration with NDG, verifies that the learner has knowledge of open vs closed source applications, basic hardware concepts, Linux OS components, command line usage, file management, creating/restoring backups, system security, user/group permissions, and simple scripting. Learner has completed 24 prescriptive labs using a real Linux OS on a virtual machine interacting with the Linux operating system and build on their skills and knowledge as they progress through the course.
